name: Magic Weapon

upcast.text: The bonus becomes +2 with a level 3-5 slot and +3 with a level 6+ slot.

summary: A nonmagical weapon you touch becomes magic with +1 to attack and damage rolls (+2 or +3 at higher slots).
text: Touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends it is a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls. The spell ends early if you cast it again. With a level 3 to 5 spell slot the bonus is +2, and with a level 6 or higher slot it is +3.
